title: Act: Apply store focus to SceneObjects and write it from the keyboard handler
summary: Add applyFocus to BootScene.onStateChange and setFocusedObject to onKeyDown
description: BootScene reads focusedObjectId on every store change and focuses the matching SceneObject, blurring the others. The Tab/arrow branch of onKeyDown stores the focused id.
definition_of_done: Store focus drives highlight; tsc passes

steps.action: At the top of onStateChange, before the null-state return, read focusedObjectId from useGameStore.getState() and loop this.sceneObjects: if o.spec.id === focusedObjectId call o.focus(), else if o.isFocused call o.blur().
steps.expected: Changing the store focus id focuses exactly the matching object.

steps.action: In the delta !== 0 branch, after moveFocus, compute const focusedId = this.sceneObjects.find((o) => o.isFocused)?.spec.id ?? null; call useGameStore.getState().setFocusedObject(focusedId) and reuse focusedId in the existing focusChange emit.
steps.expected: Tab stores the focused id and still emits focusChange.
